name: n8n
description: Connect to your n8n instance with workflow tools and all 15 n8n skills. Configure the instance URL and API key in plugin settings.

api_url.title: n8n instance URL
api_url.description: Base URL of your n8n instance, without /api/v1. Use HTTPS except for a local instance.

api_key.title: n8n API key
api_key.description: Create a key in n8n Settings → n8n API. Grant permissions for the workflows and resources you intend to manage.

mcp_access_token.title: n8n instance MCP access token
mcp_access_token.description: Only needed for instance-level MCP features, such as persisted agents and dynamic node resource lookups. Enable MCP access in n8n and paste its access token here.
